title: PR 71: split it, and iterate the PRD?
subtitle: Read the case, make the two calls, then press Copy for agent

nodes.label: 5–0 for a split at medium confidence. Same model, one packet: one opinion, five times
Without doctor and the manifest: build ok, validate ok, 866/875 pass. All 9 failures are inventory tests
Docs, not code: the contract ADR (29 refs) and site/commands.md (34) describe doctor
Four requirement gaps the spec can't settle alone, plus which PR ships which story
The case for an iteration PRD

sections.head: For
items: No story covers an install made before the manifest, the audited one included (finding 8)
AC-1.2 and AC-2.3 conflict in a subfolder of a repo; the spec picked a side (finding 11)
AC-5.1 doesn't say where qmd is checked from (finding 7)
AC-4.1 promises the rules, not their current text (finding 9)
A split moves US-5 and US-6 to a later PR; the PRD should say so

sections.head: Against
items: The goals don't change, so it is extra process
A spec iteration can carry findings 7, 9 and 10 alone

sections.head: Read
items: Gaps 1 and 2 are missing or conflicting requirements, not mechanisms, so they belong in the PRD

options.label: Split: setup slice now, check-and-repair later

options.hint: the jury's fallback; one ADR, a longer wait

The AC-1.2 vs AC-2.3 conflict is decided in the spec, below the PRD
